subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should Volcengine Lite UUID keys be supported for the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` route, routed only through coding-plan models, or rejected earlier with a clear setup/runtime diagnostic?
rationale: The repository code shows the current route split, but only maintainer/vendor contract knowledge or a credentialed live test can decide whether the Lite entitlement is supposed to work on the general DeepSeek endpoint.

options.title: Require live contract proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or credentialed tester checks the Lite key against both current Volcengine endpoints and records the intended product behavior.

options.title: Constrain Lite to coding-plan models
options.body: Update the plugin-owned setup/catalog behavior so Lite users are directed to `volcengine-plan/*` only, with docs and diagnostics explaining the limitation.

options.title: Keep one-key behavior and improve diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the current shared-key catalog but add endpoint-specific runtime guidance when Volcengine rejects a key for a general model route.

recommendation.title: Require live contract proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or credentialed tester checks the Lite key against both current Volcengine endpoints and records the intended product behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision crosses provider auth aliases, setup behavior, and model routing, and steipete has recent merged history on the provider auth alias seam.
